exceptions.reason: The Go vulnerability record is unreviewed and marks every module version as affected, while the Hysteria v2.8.2 release explicitly contains the server-side sniff OOM fix. Sub2API uses the newer v2.12.2 client package only.
exceptions.mitigation: Keep Hysteria at v2.8.2 or newer, do not import its server sniff implementation, and remove this exception when the Go vulnerability metadata is corrected.
